newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana cocoa processor votes out chairman-state TV.
newsitem.headline: Ghana cocoa processor votes out chairman-state TV.

text.p: The board of one of Ghana's biggest cocoa processors, the part-German-owned West African Mills Company (WAMCO) in Takoradi, voted its chairman out of office on Thursday, state television reported.
The television gave no reason for the vote against Isaac Adjei-Maafo and did not name his successor. Adjei-Maafo was not available for comment but his wife told Reuters that the report was correct.
German company Walter Schroeder/Hosta has a 60 percent stake in WAMCO. The government of Ghana, through Ghana's Cocoa Marketing Board (COCOBOD), holds the remaining 40 percent.
In 1995, WAMCO processed 50,000 of cocoa beans into 20,000 tonnes of cocoa butter.
